answer: Secretly re-grade a random sample of settled verdicts with an independent panel, and slash any grader whose score on an audited item deviates past a threshold. Because the sample is drawn unpredictably after the fact, a colluder cannot know which item sits on the ledge of inspection, so cheating anywhere carries an expected penalty of audit-rate times the slash. Tune that product above the per-item gain and dishonesty is net-negative even when the sample rate rests near its nadir — one ember of random audit deters the whole ring. The only verdict safe on every item is the honest one.
